basic_details.job_title: RGGEC Adjunct Faculty/Resource Persons Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Rajiv Gandhi Govt. Engineering College Kangra at Nagrota Bagwan (H.P.) will interview candidates for engagement as Adjunct Faculty/Resource Persons purely on lecture/hourly basis, paid Rs. 1000/- per hour (maximum Rs. 3000/- per day), for the even semesters from January 2027 to May 2027 of the 2026-27 session. There are 4 posts, 2 in Computer Science & Engg. and 2 in Electrical Engg. The essential qualification is M. Tech./M.E./ Ph.D. in Concerned Branch of Engineering. Hard copies of the application must reach the college office by 2nd Dec., 2026 (5 p.m.).

content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the age limit or the application fee.

rows.details: Rajiv Gandhi Govt. Engineering College Kangra at Nagrota Bagwan (H.P.)
Adjunct Faculty/Resource Persons (Computer Science & Engg.; Electrical Engg.)
Even semesters (Jan. 2027 to May. 2027), academic session 2026-27
Rs. 1000/- per hour, maximum to Rs. 3000/- per day
Prescribed application proforma; hard copy to reach the college office

content_sections.heading: About the College
content_sections.text: The notice is issued by the Office of the Director cum Principal of Rajiv Gandhi Govt. Engineering College, Kangra at Nagrota Bagwan, VPO Massal, Tehsil Nagrota Bagwan, Distt. Kangra (HP)-176047. The letterhead states that the college is approved by AICTE, New Delhi and affiliated to HPTU, Hamirpur (H.P.). The engagement is of experts to deliver lectures to students for covering the syllabus.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists 4 posts in all. The category-wise break-up is not printed.

rows.pay: Rs. 1000/- per hour, maximum to Rs. 3000/- per day
Rs. 1000/- per hour, maximum to Rs. 3000/- per day

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Both posts have the same requirements, as printed in the notice. Experience is counted after obtaining the essential qualification only. Experience gained before acquiring it is not counted. Preference will be given to retired persons. The notice prints no age limit. Candidates should check the official notice for any further eligibility detail.

rows.essential_educational_qualification: M. Tech./M.E./ Ph.D. in Concerned Branch of Engineering
rows.experience: 10-15 years in respected industry and government organization

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Remuneration is Rs. 1000/- per hour, maximum to Rs. 3000/- per day, paid out of SWF of the Institute. Teaching load of total 06 lectures per week will be allocated to the selected Adjunct Faculty/Resource Person. The engagement is purely on lecture/hourly basis for the even semesters (Jan. 2027 to May. 2027) of the academic session 2026-27. The posts are to be filled on stop gap arrangement. Depending upon performance and till joining of the regular faculty, the engagement may be continued in coming semester(s).

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for RGGEC Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Take the prescribed application proforma "Application for Engagement of Adjunct Faculty/Resource Persons (CSE/Electrical Engg.)" from the institute website www.rggec.ac.in . Fill in the applicant's name, father's name, address, date of birth, contact number, e-mail ID, academic details (Matriculation to Ph.D. or any other higher qualification) and experience details, then sign and date it. Attach self-attested copies of Educational Qualifications and Experience Certificates. Send the hard copy so that it reaches the office of the Director/Principal at the college address given above latest by 2nd Dec., 2026 (5 p.m.). Contact details printed in the notice: phone 01892-249188; e-mail [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The college will conduct an interview. The eligible/shortlisted candidates will be intimated separately for the interview. The interview date and venue are not specified in the notice. No TA/DA shall be paid for attending the interview.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The institute reserves the right to fill or not to fill the posts. The engagement is on stop gap arrangement and may be continued in coming semester(s) only as the notice describes.

faq.question: Q1. How many Adjunct Faculty/Resource Person posts are there at RGGEC Kangra?
faq.answer: There are 4 posts: 02 in Computer Science & Engg. and 02 in Electrical Engg.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The hard copy of the application must reach the college office latest by 2nd Dec., 2026 (5 p.m.).

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: M. Tech./M.E./ Ph.D. in Concerned Branch of Engineering, with 10-15 years of experience in respected industry and government organization, counted after obtaining the essential qualification.

faq.question: Q4. How much will be paid?
faq.answer: Rs. 1000/- per hour, maximum to Rs. 3000/- per day, paid out of SWF of the Institute.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply?
faq.answer: Use the prescribed application proforma from www.rggec.ac.in and send the hard copy with self-attested copies of Educational Qualifications and Experience Certificates to the office of the Director/Principal.

faq.question: Q6. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is purely on lecture/hourly basis for January 2027 to May 2027 on stop gap arrangement. It may be continued in coming semester(s) depending on performance and till the regular faculty joins.

faq.question: Q7. Who gets preference?
faq.answer: Preference will be given to retired persons.

faq.question: Q8. How many lectures will the selected person take?
faq.answer: A teaching load of total 06 lectures per week will be allocated to the selected Adjunct Faculty/Resource Person.

faq.question: Q9. Will TA/DA be paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no TA/DA shall be paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q10. How will shortlisted candidates know about the interview?
faq.answer: The eligible/shortlisted candidates will be intimated separately for the interview.
